PROJECT 1VR / AI / RESEARCH

AI-Driven
VR Museum.

A virtual Bianzhong exhibition where visitors talk to an embodied AI guide and play ancient Chinese chime bells.

Unreal Engine 5ConvaiVR

CORE DEVELOPER

Scene & interaction

Built the UE5 museum environment, lighting, materials and interaction functions. Bell colliders trigger prerecorded chime sounds when contacted by the virtual mallet.

Speech & digital human

Connected Convai dialogue and speech services to the VR guide. Configured the virtual character and interface, and adjusted the system for the research experiment.

Experiment & research

Participated in experimental work, data organization and paper preparation for a study comparing extraverted and introverted verbal styles in AI guides.

IEEE VRW 2026 / FOURTH AUTHOR

Does AI’s
Personality Matter?

A controlled comparison of verbally extraverted and introverted AI-driven guides in a VR museum experience.

Read the publication

30participants

Study results & limitations

Group means: extraverted / introverted

MeasureMeansp
Factual recall (out of 7)4.73 / 3.93.039
NASA-TLX24.63 / 29.28.030
Duration (seconds)682.07 / 646.27.037
Co-presence (1–7)5.53 / 4.27.007
Psychological involvement (1–7)5.57 / 4.70.018

Emotional valence was also higher in the extraverted condition (p < .001). Utterance count, behavioral engagement, arousal and dominance did not differ significantly. These findings concern a small, homogeneous sample and this particular museum experience; only verbal personality varied. Adaptive guidance was a future direction, not an implemented feature.
